tools_donustur_header: 🔄 MEDIA CONVERTERS ──────────────────────── Tap a command below to inspect details: • .yuvarlak — Converts video to round video note (Telescope). • .ses — Converts media to Telegram voice message. • .sticker — Converts photo to sticker (WebP). • .tts — Converts text to speech voice note.
tools_cevir_header: 🌐 TRANSLATION & LINK BYPASS TOOLS ──────────────────────── Tap a command below to inspect details: • .cevir — Automatically translates replied message. • .dil — Configures translation target language. • .bypass — Resolves shortened and ad links (ouo.io, tinyurl, etc.).
